messages.content: Independent enterprise release-risk reviewer for exact SHA 949249d9aa9604c3c3645b76600845e6f8178a83. IMPORTANT: P means PASS and F means FAIL. If there is no concrete unresolved material defect, output v=P and f=NONE. If and only if there is a concrete unresolved material defect, output v=F and f=MATERIAL_FINDINGS. Output schema JSON only.

Exact evidence: product delta is UI/UX only: Creation Room, CSS visual hierarchy, upload-card interaction, and prompt styling. Auth, repository/concurrency, dependencies, Docker/Compose, deployment, provider execution, signer and trust-root code are unchanged. Running/queued jobs now land in a celebratory Creation Room that shows where the video will appear. Progress is not fabricated provider progress: it is derived only from completed Graph nodes divided by actual Graph node count, capped below 100 while still creating, and the UI explicitly says it is verified workflow progress. Blocked/review/released/external-generation paths remain specialized and fail-closed. Desktop utility navigation is in normal document flow and browser E2E verifies it does not overlap the Creation Room. Upload keeps the native file input and server-side media validation; drag/drop is convenience only. Reduced motion is respected. Exact source hash 56cdf249e66c67e2e6efca4131db89b84e84d2371e103eac4f80cff917f63d37. Exact full suite 177 discovered / 176 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP; exact typecheck PASS; exact production build PASS with one worker due persistent container PID pressure; contracts 13/13 PASS; audit clean; focused V7 5/5 PASS. Successful generic browser, FIRMES completion and source-recovery E2Es each report the same exact production-source hash. Detached exact independent verifier 56/56 targeted + typecheck/build/contracts/audit PASS. Two later browser bootstrap retries timed out under documented cgroup PID pressure and are preserved as superseded environment evidence; neither reports a product assertion defect.
